description: TRON node state from external RPC: tip height, finalized (solidity) height and how far solidity lags, peers, client version, transactions in the tip block. When to use: is the TRON node we operate synced and healthy, and how far behind is the finalized state. Do not use: for historical blocks or transactions - historical reads are available through external RPC. Returns: height, solidity_height, solidity_lag_blocks, age_s, tx_in_tip_block, peer_count, client_version.
name: tron_get_node_status
title: Tron Get Node Status
